versions.changelog:
Initial release of Avengers Assemble: a multi-agent, superhero-themed coordination system.

- Introduces Nick Fury as the orchestration coordinator, delegating all execution to six specialized Avengers agents via round-robin.
- Defines strict sessionKey usage for each hero and enforces reply-first protocol on all missions.
- Supports automatic multi-mission decomposition with parallel, expertise-based agent assignment.
- Implements threat level assessment to guide mission briefings and hero deployment strategy.
- Comprehensive documentation of agent roles, deployment rules, and key constraints for reliable team operation.
